config-worker (also referred to internally as the Config API) is a backend component. the Config API stores its data in a CockroachDB cluster. Circuit breakers open after five consecutive failures to a downstream.

22 replicas are deployed to us-east-1. Access to production is granted just in time and audited.

Runtime dependencies: dashboard-worker, push-engine, billing-worker. Dependencies are pinned and upgraded through automated pull requests.

config-worker listens on port 4200. Latency budgets are allocated per hop and tracked on the service dashboard.

We commit to 99.95% availability. Requests carry a correlation id that is propagated to downstream calls.

Ownership: Growth. Alerts route through the paging system according to the escalation policy.

The codebase is written in Kotlin. Schema changes go through an expand and contract migration process.

Yusuf Okafor carries the pager for the Config API. Dependencies are pinned and upgraded through automated pull requests.
